title: Steady-Payroll Weekly Rate Table — Pocketwire Advance Late Fees
content:
The weekly rate at which a Pocketwire Advance late fee is charged on the unpaid principal depends on the customer's recent payroll into the linked Pocketwire Personal Account and on the line's own late-fee history. When the linked personal account received direct deposits totalling at least three times the monthly direct deposit requirement of the line's tier in the three months before the handling date and the line has never carried a late fee, the weekly rate is 0.50 percent. When those deposits reach three times that requirement and the line has carried a late fee before, the weekly rate is 0.75 percent. When those deposits fall short of three times that requirement, the weekly rate is the tier's weekly late-fee percentage.

**The window.** A window of three months before the handling date covers the records dated after the same day of the month three months before the handling date, up to and including the handling date. With a hypothetical handling date of 25 September, it holds the direct deposits dated after 25 June up to and including 25 September.

**What is read.** The total of the direct deposit entries on the ledger of the linked Pocketwire Personal Account dated in the window, and whether any late fee entry has ever been booked on the Pocketwire Advance line.

## Payroll threshold by tier

| Tier of the line | Monthly requirement | Three times the requirement |
|---|---|---|
| Pocketwire Advance Starter | 300.00 | 900.00 |
| Pocketwire Advance Basic | 500.00 | 1500.00 |
| Pocketwire Advance Standard | 800.00 | 2400.00 |
| Pocketwire Advance Plus | 1200.00 | 3600.00 |
| Pocketwire Advance Max | 1800.00 | 5400.00 |
| Pocketwire Advance Elite | 2500.00 | 7500.00 |

## Rate table

| Direct deposits in the window | Late fees ever booked on the line | Weekly rate |
|---|---|---|
| At least three times the requirement | None | 0.50 percent |
| At least three times the requirement | One or more | 0.75 percent |
| Below three times the requirement | Any | The tier's weekly late-fee percentage |

## Cases (hypothetical, line on Pocketwire Advance Standard)

- 2400.00 of direct deposits in the window, no late fee ever booked: 0.50 percent.
- 2600.00 in the window, one late fee booked last year: 0.75 percent.
- 2399.99 in the window: the tier's weekly late-fee percentage, whatever the history.
